title: Japanese Ramen Noodle Soup
description: A traditional Japanese noodle soup made with rich miso broth and topped with various ingredients. This recipe serves 4 and can be customized to suit your taste.
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and whisk in the miso paste until dissolved.
Add the soy sauce and stir to combine.
Cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions and drain.
Divide the noodles among four bowls.
Ladle the hot miso broth over the noodles.
Top each bowl with sliced green onions, shiitake mushrooms, and scallions.
